correctness.rationale: For n>=1, q=2^e, the earlier general Boolean-cocycle theorem supplies the exact weighted rank generating function. In tripartite colors R=(3n²-s1s2-s1s3-s2s3)/2 reaches 2n² iff two levels are pure with opposite colors. Count 6(2^n-1) colorings/2 with orbit weight q^{2n²}. For concentration partition coloring configurations into six eta-near-max sectors and their complement; low-defect summation gives base 2^{2H2(.01)}max(1+q^-2,2q^-2(1-.01))<2 versus ground-state 2^n, complement has uniform O(2^{3n}q^{-delta n²}); hence exponentially small loss for fixed q. n1-12 independent binomial sums matched exact maximum multiplicity. Original general rank polynomial is not claimed new.
